body.summary: runCrossFileResolver gains mode ('full'|'settle'|'repository', default 'repository') and committedFiles; Pass 0 promotes rows whose awaited target is stored; Pass 2 skips awaiting rows and writes 'ambiguous' / 'no-candidate'+'no-match' in every mode; rows awaiting an unstored file are classed by selectFile; full mode classes unattempted rows; result gains completedById and pendingByClass; runSettlePass makes one 'settle' call with the settled files; resolveAfterReconcile passes 'repository'. Two stakeholder decisions recorded on the s1 LLD's feedback record (2026-10-18, entries 79b127bb and 60830321, commits 3f0c0dec and 9eca857a): (1) the per-file resolver records meta.targetFile on resolved relative imports, so t8's scope includes src/indexer/resolver.ts (a pending row holds only the file id, a hash, and the design named no source for the path); (2) the JSON.parse check is met by its outcome: the parser keeps 'parse' on its built-in list (else JSON.parse would resolve by name to an imported class's parse), so a built-in call creates no row and a complete repository stays complete, while an unresolvable library call is 'no-candidate'/'no-match'. Mutations and the sweep: S001/t8-evidence.md.
